lesson_description: In this lesson, students will delve into the concept of Multi-Model AI, understanding its foundational principles, its significance in AI development, and how it contrasts with traditional AI. Students will also explore various types of models used in Multi-Model AI and how these models collaborate to address intricate problems. The lesson will incorporate interactive activities to enhance students' comprehension of these concepts.

subtopics.title: Foundational Principles of Multi-Model AI
subtopics.description: In this subtopic, we will explore the fundamental principles that underpin Multi-Model AI. We will discuss how different models can work together to solve complex problems and the importance of these models in the development of AI. Estimated character count: 450

subtopics.title: Types of Multi-Model AI Models and Their Applications
subtopics.description: We will delve into the various types of models used in Multi-Model AI, including but not limited to neural networks, decision trees, and reinforcement learning. We will also examine how these models collaborate and how they can be applied to solve real-world problems. Estimated character count: 550
